Name: CRTfx
Author: MordragonOne
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#ff3b3b]/[/color][color=#3bff3b]/[/color][color=#3b8bff]/ [/color]CRT[i]fx[/i][/b][/size]
[i]Play Stardew Valley like it's on an old CRT TV![/i][/center]
[line]

[size=4][b]📺 About[/b][/size]
CRTfx makes Stardew Valley look like it's on an old TV or monitor, complete with scanlines, curved screen, phosphor mask, optional flicker, and more...

[line]
[size=4][b]🆕 What's new in 1.1[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Presets that imitate different hardware[/*]
[*]Blur, for a more realistic, soft picture[/*]
[*]Three phosphor mask types: Stripes, Dots, and Slots[/*]
[*]Curvature split into two settings[/*]
[*]Old settings preserved when updating[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🥁 Main Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Simulated screen curvature[/*]
[*]Scanlines[/*]
[*]Phosphor masks[/*]
[*]Color fringing[/*]
[*]Blur and glow[/*]
[*]Vignette effect[/*]
[*]Brightness adjustment[/*]
[*]Optional flicker (off by default)[/*]
[*]All settings adjustable in game with Generic Mod Config Menu, or in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font][/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]⚙️ Settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Enabled [/b](default: true): whether the effect is on when the game starts[/*]
[*][b]ToggleKey [/b](default: F9): the key that turns the effect on and off[/*]
[*][b]Preset[/b]: (default is now CRTfx 1.1) which look is used[/*]
[/list]
Custom settings (used when Preset is set to [b]Custom[/b]):
[list]
[*][b]Curvature[/b]: how much the screen bends side to side (bends the top and bottom edges)[/*]
[*][b]CurvatureVertical[/b]: how much the screen bends top to bottom (bends the left and right edges)[/*]
[*][b]Vignette[/b]: how dark the corners and edges are[/*]
[*][b]ColorFringe[/b]: how much the colors separate at the edges[/*]
[*][b]Blur[/b]: how soft the picture is, side to side[/*]
[*][b]ScanlineStrength[/b]: how dark the scanlines are[/*]
[*][b]ScanlineSpacing[/b]: how far apart the scanlines are[/*]
[*][b]MaskType[/b]: the phosphor pattern: Stripes (aperture grille), Dots (shadow mask) or Slots (slot mask)[/*]
[*][b]MaskStrength[/b]: how visible the phosphor mask is[/*]
[*][b]Glow[/b]: how much bright areas glow[/*]
[*][b]Brightness[/b]: overall screen brightness[/*]
[*][b]Flicker[/b]: how much the screen flickers (DO NOT turn on Flicker if you are sensitive, please.)[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [color=#e06c75][b](required)[/b][/color][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [color=#98c379](optional, for in-game settings)[/color][/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]🔧 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Start the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=2][i]To uninstall, delete the CRTfx folder from your Mods folder.[/i][/size]

[line]
[size=4][b]⚠️ Compatibility[/b][/size]
Tested on [b]Windows[/b], [b]Linux[/b], and [b]Android[/b] so far. If you play on macOS, please post in the comments whether it works for you. Thank you to everyone who posted already.

For the best results, leave [b]Hardware Cursor[/b] off in the game's Options, so the mouse pointer bends with the picture and lines up with what you click.

On Windows, if you want to take a screenshot with the effect, use the shortcut: Win + Alt + PrntScr.
